logline: 잿더미 곁에서 일하던 소녀가 하룻밤 무도회에 가고, 열두 시에 뛰쳐나온다.
destination: 궁의 무도회장 — 열두 시 종이 울리는 자리
protagonist: 잿빛 옷을 입고 부엌에서 일하는 열여덟 소녀
anchor: a girl of eighteen in a patched grey dress, ash on her hands
palette: ash grey, warm amber, pale silver, deep blue, hearth orange

cinder.label: 소녀
cinder.desc: a girl of eighteen, fair hair tied back, patched grey dress, ash on her hands and apron

sisters.label: 언니들
sisters.desc: two young women in wide silk gowns with piled hair and fans, painted faces

fairy.label: 낯선 부인
fairy.desc: an old woman in a pale grey cloak, white hair, a thin stick in one hand

prince.label: 왕자
prince.desc: a young man in his twenties, dark hair, braided blue coat, white gloves

kitchen.label: 저택 부엌
kitchen.desc: a stone kitchen with a wide hearth, hanging pots, a long scrubbed table

yard.label: 달빛 마당
yard.desc: a cobbled yard at night, a vegetable patch, a low wall, moon overhead

ballroom.label: 무도회장
ballroom.desc: a candlelit hall with a broad staircase, mirrors, dancers in wide gowns

beats.beat: 소녀가 부엌 잿더미 곁에서 불을 헤집는다.
beats.visual: a girl in a patched grey dress crouched by a hearth of ashes, poker in hand
beats.motion: ash lifts steadily around the poker

beats.visual: two young women in fine gowns waving a card, passing a girl in a grey dress
beats.motion: the card waves steadily above them

beats.visual: two women in gowns standing over a girl pressing cloth at a kitchen table
beats.motion: her iron moves steadily across the cloth

beats.visual: a girl alone by a cold hearth, the house dark and empty around her
beats.motion: embers dim steadily in the grate

beats.visual: an old woman in a pale cloak standing in a dim kitchen before a startled girl
beats.motion: her cloak settles steadily around her

beats.visual: an old woman in a cloak pointing at a large pumpkin in a moonlit yard
beats.motion: her hand holds steadily toward the pumpkin

beats.visual: a pumpkin swelling into the shape of a coach in a moonlit yard, light around it
beats.motion: the shape swells steadily into a coach

beats.beat: 소녀가 은빛 옷을 입고 마차에 오른다.
beats.visual: a girl in a silver gown stepping up into a coach, a cloaked woman watching
beats.motion: she rises steadily into the coach

beats.visual: a girl in a silver gown descending a broad staircase into a candlelit ballroom
beats.motion: she descends steadily into the light

beats.beat: 젊은 왕자가 그 앞에 손을 내민다.
beats.visual: a young man in a braided coat holding out his hand to a girl in a silver gown
beats.motion: his hand reaches steadily toward her

beats.visual: a tall clock face in a ballroom with both hands nearing the top, dancers beyond
beats.motion: the hands climb steadily toward twelve

beats.visual: a girl in a silver gown running down a broad staircase, skirts gathered in her hands
beats.motion: she runs steadily down the steps

beats.beat: 왕자가 계단에서 유리 구두를 집어 든다.
beats.visual: a young man lifting a small glass slipper from a stone step, hall empty behind
beats.motion: the slipper rises steadily in his hand

beats.visual: an empty stone staircase at dawn, one faint mark on a step, hall dark beyond
beats.motion: grey light spreads steadily up the steps

withheld: 유리 구두의 임자를 찾는 과정과, 언니들이 맞는 결말
